description: Makes a barcode as SVG (sized in mm, prints at exact size) or PNG (at a DPI, written into the file): EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ISBN, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5, GS1-128, Codabar, Data Matrix, GS1 Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec. EAN/UPC check digits are added when left out.

moduleMM.description: Narrowest bar in mm (default per type, e.g. 0.33 for EAN)

name: barcode_create
title: Create a barcode
